verdict.rationale: Manufact documents an official MCP server that exposes the platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs, and observability as MCP tools, so agents in Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client can manage everything. A probe confirms the dedicated docs page, and the changelog describes a guided OAuth authorization flow that returns the user to the client with a starter prompt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Manufact MCP server in use, detailed per-tool reference/connection config shown in evidence.
